expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no registered bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective.

failure_modes: A pointcloud_delta_A or region_index edit would change the executing curvature or regional emphasis without any supported mapping to the pair-shell or shape contrasts, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates while the affinity-first objective is unchanged.

A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would condition on observed-node contrast curves that show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts with no validated fit, and would not change the static teacher coordinates.
A teacher_neighbors edit would alter a count, not a distance bandwidth, and the supplied teacher provenance and fixed temperatures must be preserved.
Treating pair-kernel, moment, joint-motion or turnover diagnostics as if they were executing reward terms would be a category error; the pointcloud scalar contains none of them.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The registered edit surface (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) cannot express the Analyst's strongest reproducible contrasts, and the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). The most reproducible endpoint contrasts are short-range pair-distance shell densities pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 (endpoint_effects:9-11, q 1.5e-4/2.2e-5/9.8e-5, positive batch fraction 1.0) with pair_kernel_7.0 reversed (endpoint_effects:13, positive batch fraction 0.0); these are diagnostic observables, not terms the pointcloud reward contains, so no permitted parameter edit connects to them. The shape_yy contrast is reproducible and negative (endpoint_effects:4, q 1.5e-5, positive batch fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:158/235; regional local_cyy negative at every landmark, e.g. regional_effects:5/15/75/165/195), but shape is likewise not an executing term. Centroid translation is unsupported (endpoint_effects:0-2; branch_adjusted:77-79/231-233), so a region_index or pointcloud_delta_A edit has no defensible expected advantage. Joint-motion contrasts are the most reproducible branch-level signals and negative (branch_adjusted:74-76/151-153), but they are joint-motion summaries, not a coordinate the pointcloud curvature controls. The continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation, large relative node RMSE (0.30-0.99) and many strong sign-conflict nodes (curve_support), so a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is not supported by a validated fit; the static teacher coordinates are unchanged and only validated absolute contrast would alter regional attention. Increment and population contrasts disagree in sign for shape_xz, pair_kernel_2.5, pair_kernel_7.0 and landmark_00_softmin (increment_effects:3/4/7/10/13/14), and turnover residuals for the same local shape features are large and positive (turnover:14/17/47/134/224/227), so those features are lower priority rather than edit targets. Descendant survival credit is weak and mostly not significant after joint multiple testing (survival_effects:0/70/100/186/249/393/396) and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so it cannot justify an edit. The information audit metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, and ancestral coverage is incomplete (lineage_support), so no permitted bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent. Temperatures remain fixed (fixed_parameters; teacher_modes temperature_edits false).
